4_fee_rate.bnb_price: BNBUSD 1m index close nearest the fill (INDEX_KLINES_1m_OHLC_cache); lag median s = 883, max s = 1315

era_switch.rule: first 4h bucket from which every later bucket has more USDT- than BNB-commission fills; switch instant = first USDT fill in it

definitions.producer_book_turnover: sizing.gross × Σ_s |w_A/gn_A − w_{A−4h}/gn_{A−4h}| (the producer's own book change, executor-state free; paired only when both books exist)
definitions.executor_plan_turnover: Σ |intended_full| over SENT first maker legs (after withhold / reshape / clamp / min-notional / lot rounding) — the same population as the sim's plan_turnover
definitions.exec_turnover: Σ |fill notional| of this rid's maker + top-up fills (collapsed ledger)

params.share_weighting: NOTIONAL-weighted (v2). v1 used COUNT shares; the in-sample consistency check (sim executed / planned 0.917 vs live 0.863) showed larger orders zero-fill and get rejected more often (notional share zero 0.142 vs count 0.110), so count shares over-execute an aggregate. Changed before any V1 number.

requote_p_timeline.why: before the experiment: the MEASURED share of -5022 first legs that were requoted (n in 2_requote_leg), applied as an expected-value mix
config requote_experiment.p_requote = 0.5 (12aa2a1, deployed 09-05 11:48:11Z); first anchor with requote_p on its rows = 09-05 12Z; arm = requote_experiment.assign(rid, sym, p)

taker_fill_rate.weighting: notional-weighted among eligible legs (sent or abandoned); chase_forced (C's size-selected fill set) is abandoned far more often than the randomised chase arm, so the two are separate parameters

params.decision_offset_why: executor reads target_live at N+24:00 and captures mid_at_anchor then; the 5-minute panel boundary containing that instant is N+25:00
params.stop_eval_why: phase C / daily_nav / position readback at ~N+40
params.rule_flatten_why: §4-2 trip is judged on the N+40 NAV row; the live 09-06 trip flattened at 08:46:08Z (N+46)
params.hash_free: expected-value fill model: no random draws; the only deterministic hashes are the executor's own (chase_policy.assign_arms, requote_experiment.assign)
